findings.applicability: Critic review of structured fields against narrative scope.
findings.explanation: The critique states that the draft conforms to the catalog and that missing broker costs block only economic interpretation, yet it does not note that the binding required-data field itself declares broker costs. The contradiction was visible in the exact draft reviewed.

findings.applicability: Attribution of released aggregate results to a proposed subset.
findings.explanation: The critique distinguishes measured failures of the broader rule from unmeasured subset performance and treats temporal failure as a risk, not an observed subset result.
